title: NMAS device
description: One network device, for the NMAS device page: every panel selects the `device` variable. Built by deploy/grafana/build_nmas_device.py.

panels.title: Answering SNMP
panels.description: Whether this device answered the last SNMP scrape (30 s).

defaults.noValue: Not a target: its configuration has no SNMP. Needs attention says what to do.

panels.title: IOS CPU, 1-minute average
panels.description: IOS's own control-plane CPU over the last minute: from gRPC telemetry on IOS-XE, from SNMP on vIOS (the caption says which). The same measurement on both. Amber from 70%, red from 90%.

defaults.noValue: No IOS CPU reading. On IOS-XE it comes from telemetry, and this router is not streaming; its platform CPU is one level down.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (device) (Cisco_IOS_XE_process_cpu_oper:cpu_usage_cpu_utilization_one_minute{device="$device"}), "via", "gRPC telemetry", "", "") or (label_replace(max by (device) (cpuAvgBusy1{device="$device"}), "via", "SNMP", "", "") unless on(device) max by (device) (Cisco_IOS_XE_process_cpu_oper:cpu_usage_cpu_utilization_one_minute{device="$device"}))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: The processor memory pool in use. Amber from 80%, red from 90%.

defaults.noValue: Memory isn't available over SNMP on vIOS.

targets.expr: label_replace(100 * sum by (device) (cempMemPoolUsed{device="$device", cempMemPoolIndex="1"}) / (sum by (device) (cempMemPoolUsed{device="$device", cempMemPoolIndex="1"}) + sum by (device) (cempMemPoolFree{device="$device", cempMemPoolIndex="1"})), "via", "SNMP", "", "")

panels.title: Interfaces down that should be up
panels.description: Interfaces configured up that are not up. An interface shut down on purpose is not counted. Red from 1.

defaults.noValue: No interface reading over SNMP.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (device) ((ifOperStatus{device="$device"} != bool 1) * on(device, ifIndex) (ifAdminStatus{device="$device"} == bool 1)), "via", "SNMP", "", "")

panels.title: Routing neighbours in a wrong state
panels.description: OSPF and OSPFv3 neighbours down, attempting, initialising or stuck forming (exstart, exchange, loading), and BGP peers configured up and not established. Two-way is NOT counted: it is the expected state between routers that are neither the designated router nor its backup. Red from 1.

targets.expr: count(({__name__=~"ospfNbrState|ospfv3NbrState", device="$device"} < 4) or ({__name__=~"ospfNbrState|ospfv3NbrState", device="$device"} > 4 < 8) or (cbgpPeer2State{device="$device"} != 6 and on(device, cbgpPeer2RemoteAddr) cbgpPeer2AdminStatus{device="$device"} == 2)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Critical syslog lines, last 24 h
panels.description: Syslog lines of severity 0 to 2 (emergency, alert, critical) from this device in the last 24 hours. Red from 1; the lines are on the Logs tab.

panels.title: Up for
panels.description: Time since the device's SNMP agent started, shown only where the device's clock keeps real time (rate at least 90%).

defaults.noValue: Not shown: this device's own clock runs slow, so its uptime count under-reads. Reboots are counted beside it, and the clock's rate is its own panel.

panels.title: Reboots detected
panels.description: Times the uptime counter reset in the chosen range: a reboot, counted reliably however slowly the device's clock runs. Amber from 1.

defaults.noValue: Not a target: no SNMP.

panels.title: Device clock rate
panels.description: How fast the device's own clock runs against real time, over the last hour (100% keeps time). The emulated vIOS switches run slow (C9); NTP corrects the time of day, not this rate. Red below 70%, amber below 90%.

defaults.noValue: Not a target: no SNMP, or less than an hour of history.

panels.title: Telemetry stream
panels.description: Seconds since the newest sample of this device's interface telemetry. Amber after 90 s (three missed scrapes), red after 5 min; after that the series are stale and the panel says no stream, never fresh.

defaults.noValue: No stream: nothing received in 5 min. IOS-XE devices stream once the monitoring profile subscribes them; vIOS has no telemetry.

panels.title: LLDP neighbours
panels.description: Physical neighbours this device reports over LLDP. No colour: the right number depends on how it is cabled.

defaults.noValue: None reported over LLDP.

panels.title: Traffic in
panels.description: Traffic in per interface, from gRPC telemetry where the device streams, else SNMP. Null and VoIP-Null interfaces are left out.

defaults.noValue: No interface counters from telemetry or SNMP.

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_in_octets{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 8, "via", "gRPC telemetry", "", "") or (label_replace((label_replace((sum by (device, ifName) (rate(ifHCInOctets{device="$device", ifName!~"Nu[0-9].*|Vo[0-9].*"}[$__rate_interval]))), "name", "$1", "ifName", "(.*)")) * 8, "via", "SNMP", "", "") unless on(device) (sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_in_octets{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 8)

panels.title: Traffic out
panels.description: Traffic out per interface, from gRPC telemetry where the device streams, else SNMP. Null and VoIP-Null interfaces are left out.

defaults.noValue: No interface counters from telemetry or SNMP.

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_out_octets_64{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 8, "via", "gRPC telemetry", "", "") or (label_replace((label_replace((sum by (device, ifName) (rate(ifHCOutOctets{device="$device", ifName!~"Nu[0-9].*|Vo[0-9].*"}[$__rate_interval]))), "name", "$1", "ifName", "(.*)")) * 8, "via", "SNMP", "", "") unless on(device) (sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_out_octets_64{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 8)

panels.title: Errors and discards (packets per second, each interface)
Interface errors
panels.description: Interface errors, in and out together, per interface.

defaults.noValue: No interface counters from telemetry or SNMP.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_in_errors{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_out_errors{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])), "via", "gRPC telemetry", "", "") or (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (device, ifName) (rate(ifInErrors{device="$device", ifName!~"Nu[0-9].*|Vo[0-9].*"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (device, ifName) (rate(ifOutErrors{device="$device", ifName!~"Nu[0-9].*|Vo[0-9].*"}[$__rate_interval]))), "name", "$1", "ifName", "(.*)"), "via", "SNMP", "", "") unless on(device) sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_in_errors{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_out_errors{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Interface discards
panels.description: Interface discards, in and out together, per interface.

defaults.noValue: No interface counters from telemetry or SNMP.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_in_discards{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_out_discards{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])), "via", "gRPC telemetry", "", "") or (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (device, ifName) (rate(ifInDiscards{device="$device", ifName!~"Nu[0-9].*|Vo[0-9].*"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (device, ifName) (rate(ifOutDiscards{device="$device", ifName!~"Nu[0-9].*|Vo[0-9].*"}[$__rate_interval]))), "name", "$1", "ifName", "(.*)"), "via", "SNMP", "", "") unless on(device) sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_in_discards{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (device, name) (rate(Cisco_IOS_XE_interfaces_oper:interfaces_interface_statistics_out_discards{device="$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: OSPF neighbours
panels.description: Each OSPFv2 neighbour and its state, via SNMP (OSPF-MIB). Two-way is expected between routers that are neither DR nor BDR.

defaults.noValue: No OSPF neighbour: no OSPF on this device, or its OSPF table is not scraped yet.

panels.title: OSPFv3 neighbours
panels.description: Each OSPFv3 neighbour and its state, via SNMP (OSPFV3-MIB, IOS-XE only).

defaults.noValue: No OSPFv3 neighbour. vIOS does not report OSPFv3 over SNMP.

panels.title: BGP peers
panels.description: Each BGP peer, IPv4 and IPv6, and its session state, via SNMP (CISCO-BGP4-MIB).

defaults.noValue: No BGP peer on this device.

panels.title: IP SLA round-trip time
panels.description: The latest round-trip time of each IP SLA operation this device runs.

defaults.noValue: No IP SLA operation on this device.

panels.title: IP SLA operations failing
panels.description: Operations whose latest result is not ok. Red from 1.

defaults.noValue: No IP SLA operation on this device.

panels.title: IOS CPU over time
panels.description: IOS's own control-plane CPU over the chosen range, from the same source as the value at a glance.

defaults.noValue: No IOS CPU reading from telemetry or SNMP.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (device) (Cisco_IOS_XE_process_cpu_oper:cpu_usage_cpu_utilization_one_minute{device="$device"}), "via", "gRPC telemetry", "", "") or (label_replace(max by (device) (cpuAvgBusy1{device="$device"}), "via", "SNMP", "", "") unless on(device) max by (device) (Cisco_IOS_XE_process_cpu_oper:cpu_usage_cpu_utilization_one_minute{device="$device"}))

panels.title: Interface status
panels.description: Each interface's operational state, via SNMP. Null and VoIP-Null are left out.

defaults.noValue: No interface reading over SNMP.

panels.title: Syslog lines by severity
panels.description: Syslog lines per interval by severity (0 emergency to 7 debug). The lines themselves are on the Logs tab.

defaults.noValue: No syslog line from this device in the range.

panels.title: Interface flaps
panels.description: Each interface's flap count since its counters were cleared.

defaults.noValue: IOS-XE telemetry only: this device does not stream.

panels.title: Device clock rate over time
panels.description: The device's clock rate against real time, over time (100% keeps time).

defaults.noValue: Not a target: no SNMP, or less than an hour of history.

panels.title: SNMP collection time
panels.description: How long one SNMP read of this device takes, per job; its limit is 30 s.

defaults.noValue: Not a target: no SNMP.

panels.title: Platform CPU (the whole route processor)
panels.description: The route processor's whole CPU, forwarding engine included. On a virtual router the forwarding engine busy-polls continuously whether or not packets arrive (measured on r3: ucode_pkt_PQF0 alone at 90% and more), so a high flat line is normal here; IOS CPU at a glance is the figure that shows strain.

defaults.noValue: vIOS reports no platform figure apart from IOS's; IOS CPU is at a glance.
